subject: Scheduling: Technical demo and IT security sync
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@microgrid.energy>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2024 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request for product overview - scheduling

Hi Anna —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. I'm the SDR on this account — congrats on the trial! We want to schedule a short technical demo with an AE (Grace) and SE (Karthik) so we can cover:

- 20 minute product walkthrough (AE)
- 25 minute technical deep-dive (SE) — network/whitelisting and security checklist items
- 15 minute Q&A and next steps

Are any of these windows workable for you and your IT/security folks (times in BST):

- Wed 17 Jul: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu 18 Jul: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–16:00

If those don't work, please share two windows and I'll coordinate. I've attached our quick security overview for IT ahead of the call.

Attachments: MicroGrid-Security-Overview.pdf (summary: SOC2 controls, network inbound IPs, data residency)

Thanks — I looped in Grace (AE) and Karthik (SE) to confirm availability.

Best,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Klein <anna.klein@microgrid.energy>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@microgrid.energy>, it-security@microgrid.energy
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2024 14:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request for product overview - scheduling

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the note. We're keen to see the demo. Our security lead Mike Jackson (cc'd) would like to join for the technical portion. We're in BST (UK). Our team prefers afternoon slots. Current constraints:

- Wed 17 Jul: only after 16:00 BST (back-to-back all day)
- Thu 18 Jul: free 14:00–16:30 BST (best)

Can you confirm whether the SE can cover network/IP whitelisting and a short run-through of our security questionnaire? I'm attaching the questionnaire — Mike has filled the top with context.

Also, we have a corporate calendar policy that sometimes blocks external invites; if you can send an ics and include a Teams link, that helps.

Thanks,
Anna
Head of Integrations, MicroGrid Energy
anna.klein@microgrid.energy
Attachment: microgrid-security-q3.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@microgrid.energy>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2024 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical demo and IT security sync

Hi Anna —

Great — thanks for the availability. 14:00–15:00 BST on Thu 18 Jul works for Grace/AE and Karthik/SE from our side; that'll be 09:00–10:00 EDT. We can structure it as:

- 14:00–14:20 BST: product walkthrough (me)
- 14:20–14:45 BST: technical deep-dive + security Q&A (Karthik)
- 14:45–15:00 BST: next steps / success criteria

Priyom — can you send the calendar invite (Teams + dial-in) and include the security doc as pre-read? Karthik — if there are any network or whitelisting asks, list them in the invite notes so Anna's IT team can pre-provision.

Anna — I'll add a short agenda to the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@microgrid.energy>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2024 16:20:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical demo and IT security sync

Hi all —

Quick technical notes for Anna's IT/security team so we can avoid last-minute blocks during the demo:

- Please whitelist these outbound IP ranges for the demo session: 34.208.120.0/24, 52.14.32.0/24 (we'll provide a more exhaustive list in the follow-up doc).
- Allow outbound TLS (443) to *.redwoodinference.com and to our streaming subdomains.
- If you use an egress proxy, let us know and we'll provide a fallback TURN/STUN address.
- We're happy to run a short connectivity check 15 minutes before the slot if you want.

I'll attach a one-page network checklist to the invite. Priyom — please include these in the invite notes and send the Teams link.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anna Klein <anna.klein@microgrid.energy>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@microgrid.energy>, it-security@microgrid.energy
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2024 08:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical demo and IT security sync

Hi team —

Thanks for the details. Mike and I reviewed the options and we need to shift slightly later due to an internal board prep meeting. Can we move to Thu 18 Jul, 15:00–16:00 BST instead? That still fits our originally requested window and gives Mike time to join for the technical portion.

I've attached the partially completed security questionnaire for your review. Karthik — please confirm the IP ranges align with what you expect and whether a 15:00 start is still okay for your side (given US morning).

Anna

Subject: Confirmed: Demo Thu 18 Jul 15:00–16:00 BST (invite attached)

Thanks everyone — slot confirmed for Thu 18 Jul, 15:00–16:00 BST. I created and sent a calendar invite with:

- Teams link + dial-in
- Agenda and pre-reads (MicroGrid-Security-Overview.pdf, network checklist, security questionnaire)
- ICS: demo-invite.ics attached

I've also added Soojin from our CS team to the invite so she can lead next-step logistics post-demo. Mike — thanks for joining; if you want a pre-call connectivity check we can do 15 minutes before the start.

See you Thursday —
Priyom Das
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
